integrity: Stationary weights are verified by a telescoping global balance, the half-filling sign by strict moment log-convexity, the mesoscopic limit by an exact symmetrized Fourier determinant, and the undeformed formula by exact hypergeometric counting. The finite checker is supporting evidence, not an infinite proof. Publication priority is provisional where inaccessible or unindexed work may exist.
scientific_limitations: The deformed-model phase law gives eventual signs at fixed mesoscopic offsets; it does not classify all finite-size densities or the boundary c^2=p. The t=1 case admits a complete finite-size sign formula. No claim about time-dependent correlations, other capacities, or experimental estimation errors.
title: A square-root singleton-association window in two-capacity exclusion
